feature ss01 {
# GSUB feature: Stylistic Set 1
# Lookups: 1

  featureNames {
    name "Lowercase Brackets";
  };

  sub parenleft by parenleft.lc;
  sub parenright by parenright.lc;
  sub bracketleft by bracketleft.lc;
  sub bracketright by bracketright.lc;
  sub braceleft by braceleft.lc;
  sub braceright by braceright.lc;

} ss01;

feature ss02 {
# GSUB feature: Stylistic Set 2
# Lookups: 1

  featureNames {
    name "Undotted Zero";
  };

  sub zero by zero.alt;

} ss02;

feature calt {
# GSUB feature: Contextual Alternates
# Lookups: 1
  sub @fullRight plus' by plus.uc;
  sub @fullRight space plus' by plus.uc;
  sub plus' @fullLeft by plus.uc;
  sub plus' space @fullLeft by plus.uc;

  sub @littleRight plus' by plus.lc;
  sub @littleRight space plus' by plus.lc;
  sub plus' @littleLeft by plus.lc;
  sub plus' space @littleLeft by plus.lc;

  sub @fullRight hyphen' by hyphen.uc;
  sub @fullRight space hyphen' by hyphen.uc;
  sub hyphen' @fullLeft by hyphen.uc;
  sub hyphen' space @fullLeft by hyphen.uc;

  sub @littleRight hyphen' by hyphen.lc;
  sub @littleRight space hyphen' by hyphen.lc;
  sub hyphen' @littleLeft by hyphen.lc;
  sub hyphen' space @littleLeft by hyphen.lc;

  sub @fullRight equal' by equal.uc;
  sub @fullRight space equal' by equal.uc;
  sub equal' @fullLeft by equal.uc;
  sub equal' space @fullLeft by equal.uc;

  sub @littleRight equal' by equal.lc;
  sub @littleRight space equal' by equal.lc;
  sub equal' @littleLeft by equal.lc;
  sub equal' space @littleLeft by equal.lc;

  sub @fullRight asciitilde' by asciitilde.uc;
  sub @fullRight space asciitilde' by asciitilde.uc;
  sub asciitilde' @fullLeft by asciitilde.uc;
  sub asciitilde' space @fullLeft by asciitilde.uc;

  sub @littleRight asciitilde' by asciitilde.lc;
  sub @littleRight space asciitilde' by asciitilde.lc;
  sub asciitilde' @littleLeft by asciitilde.lc;
  sub asciitilde' space @littleLeft by asciitilde.lc;

  sub @fullRight asterisk' by asterisk.uc;
  sub @fullRight space asterisk' by asterisk.uc;
  sub asterisk' @fullLeft by asterisk.uc;
  sub asterisk' space @fullLeft by asterisk.uc;

  sub @littleRight asterisk' by asterisk.lc;
  sub @littleRight space asterisk' by asterisk.lc;
  sub asterisk' @littleLeft by asterisk.lc;
  sub asterisk' space @littleLeft by asterisk.lc;

} calt;
